title: Renkon Stew
description: A hearty and comforting stew made with tender renkon and a variety of aromatic spices. This vegan stew is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add chopped malty and sauté for 2 minutes.
Add the stew, renkon, and australian, and stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in aerated and season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
